total_model.summary: Model projects 40.7 total points (GB 22, MIN 19). Biggest factors: Combined pass defense EPA allowed/play (lowers total 1.5), Expected points from both teams' scoring (season blend) (lowers total 1.5), Combined quarterback ratings (raises total 1.0). The baseline of 45.7 is the typical NFL total in the training data.
